title: Environment variables
description: Every environment variable McHarbor and its agent read, generated from the source and the configuration reference. Changing any of them means recreating the container.

flags.sensitiveHint: Holds a secret. Keep it in a secret store, never in a committed Compose file.
flags.restartHint: Read at start-up; a change applies only after the container is recreated.
flags.undocumentedHint: Read by the code but not described in the configuration reference, usually because McHarbor sets it itself for a helper container.
flags.notInCodeHint: Documented, but read by the entrypoint or Compose file rather than by the Go binary, or no longer read at all.

noDescription: No description in the configuration reference.
